title: Map first on a load
text: T-4230 measured: the demand packs opening beside the game's first state can nearly double it (3.4 s against 6.8 s on NYC, noisy). Open them a moment after the first state, so the map shows up sooner and trips arrive about 2-3 s later (a few percent of a load's trip wait)? The agent would try one worker at once and the rest after. Your call since it changes when trips appear.

title: Warm start: drop it?
text: T-3938 measured: starting a load's crowding from earlier loads cut a one-worker NYC trip calculation 38% (47 of 124 s), but 15 of 92 big lines moved past 5% (NEC -18.7%, PATH +14.6%), figures would change with each reload, and a real load has no earlier loads unless saves store them (0.46 MB per NYC save). Desktop reloads already show figures at once from the cache. Drop it? Recommended yes; the prototype is kept as notes/T-3938-warmstart.patch.
